I added `slugify` in `src/textutil.py` and seven `unittest` tests in `tests/test_slugify.py`. All seven pass with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`.

The tests cover lowercasing, collapsing runs of other characters into one "-", trimming leading and trailing dashes, and keeping digits. They also check that non-ASCII letters count as separators (`"café au lait"` becomes `"caf-au-lait"`) and that empty or symbols-only input returns `"untitled"`.
